subject: AWS Marketplace onboarding: activation flows & co-sell playbook
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: CloudOne Solutions <procurement@cloudone.com>, Lina Park <lina.park@cloudone.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace onboarding: activation flows & co-sell playbook

Hi Lina / CloudOne team —

Thanks again for the quick sync yesterday. Per our call, we're collecting the final pieces to get your AWS Marketplace listing live and align the co-sell materials so field teams have a single playbook. A few concrete items we need from you this week to avoid slipping the onboarding timeline: 

- Procurement POC + correct billing contact (we need a CloudOne email for the private offer setup).
- Confirmation on whether you want a 14-day trial SKU or a metered trial (usage-based) — this impacts CTA copy and the SKU mapping on the product page.
- Any customer-facing trust claims you want quoted verbatim (PCI/HIPAA statements, regional compliance).

Attached: redwood_marketplace_onepager.pdf (one‑pager for your product) and co-sell-playbook-v2.docx (draft we discussed).

Next steps from our side: Kimberly will draft marketplace hero & feature blurbs and Jonas will scope the partner enablement sheet. Can you confirm a procurement contact and whether trial should be time-limited or metered by EOD Thu (9/10)?

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if that's easier.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment(s): redwood_marketplace_onepager.pdf, co-sell-playbook-v2.docx

From: Lina Park <lina.park@cloudone.com>

Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace onboarding: activation flows & co-sell playbook

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the summary and the attachments. Quick answers inline: 

- Procurement POC: forwarding to procurement@cloudone.com (they're on this thread). Primary contact is Mark Ellis (mark.ellis@cloudone.com).
- Trial preference: we prefer a 14-day time-limited trial for the first release; metered trials are something we'd revisit after GA.
- Trust claims: we can call out SOC 2 Type II and data residency in US-East. I don't have formal legal language yet — Mark will loop in legal if you need certified wording.

One quick question on CTAs: our product team prefers a single primary CTA ("Start free trial") rather than a secondary purchase CTA on the hero. Will that affect procurement/privateoffer flow or billing visibility?

I'll confirm Mark's calendar availability for a call next week.

Best,
Lina
Product Partnerships
CloudOne Solutions

Hi Lina / Mark —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Mark — welcome. Based on Lina's preference for a single primary CTA (Start free trial) and a 14-day time-limited trial, here's what we propose for the product page copy and activation flow: 

1) Hero headline (short): "Deploy enterprise inference in minutes — try free for 14 days"
2) Hero CTA (primary): "Start free trial" — links to private offer sign-up (tracked)
3) Secondary CTA (under features): "Contact sales" — for enterprise purchase conversations (not prominent on hero)
4) Billing note (footnote): "No credit card required for 14-day trial; billing begins at end of trial unless canceled."

Kimberly / Jonas: can you weigh in on the hero microcopy and legal footnote? I've mirrored the trial flow to map directly to a private offer so procurement gets a single invoice event if they elect to convert.

If this looks good to CloudOne, we'll: 1) prepare the private offer template and 2) schedule a 30-min kickoff to complete SKU mapping and admin access. Proposed times: Tue 9/8 11am PT or Wed 9/9 9am PT.

Thanks,
Irene

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace onboarding: activation flows & co-sell playbook

Thanks, Irene — good draft. A couple of edits and notes from the marketplace copy perspective: 

- Hero headline tweak: prefer "Enterprise inference, ready-to-deploy — 14-day free trial" (shorter cadence and keeps the "enterprise" positioning).
- CTA language: "Start free trial" is fine as the primary. Recommend adding a small secondary link under the hero: "Talk to an engineer" (this surfaces into CoSell enablement for technical buyers).
- Trust claim phrasing (legal): suggest "SOC 2 Type II audited; data residency available in US-East" — please confirm with Mark/legal before publication.
- Footnote recommendation: move the "No credit card required" to the trial modal rather than the hero footnote; AWS sometimes filters hero footnotes in certain listings.

I'll add these suggestions to the shared Drive doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_redwood-marketplace-assets (see file: marketplace_copy_v1.md). Jonas — flagging you to draft the partner enablement one-pager that includes objection handling for the trial -> private offer conversion.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Marketplace Content & Field Enablement
Redwood Inference
